questions.prompt: Verify that f(x) = x² with domain x ≥ 0 and g(x) = √x are inverses. Explain why the domain restriction is needed.
questions.prompt_markup: Verify that f(x) = x² with domain x ≥ 0 and g(x) = √x are inverses. Explain why the domain restriction is needed.
questions.correct_answer: f(g(x)) = (√x)² = x for x ≥ 0; g(f(x)) = √(x²) = |x| = x because x ≥ 0. Without the restriction, √(x²) = |x| ≠ x for x < 0.
